commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot to Mira and add greeting
commitResults.messageBody: Establish Level-0 with a distinct bot identity, startup greeting, and clean exit. Update the documentation and ignore Java bytecode to keep submissions clean.
Complete Level-1 by reading console input in a loop, echoing each command, and ending the session when the user enters bye.
Complete Level-2 by retaining arbitrary task text in insertion order and displaying the numbered list on request.
Complete Level-3 by introducing a Task model with completion state, numbered status display, and mark or unmark commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Model todo, deadline, and event tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Complete Level-4 with a shared Task base class and specialized todo, deadline, and event types while preserving date and time text as entered.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid commands with clear errors
commitResults.messageBody: Complete Level-5 with a recoverable MiraException flow and validation for blank descriptions, malformed schedules, unsupported commands, and invalid task numbers.
Complete Level-6 by removing a task via its one-based list number and reporting both the removed task and updated task count.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use enums for commands and task types
commitResults.messageBody: Complete A-Enums by replacing command strings and task type symbols with dedicated enums, while retaining existing behavior and documenting the final design.

Encode task fields so persistence preserves Unicode and delimiter
characters without depending on the operating system.

Load tasks at startup and save immediately after each successful
task-list mutation so data survives unexpected exits.

Integrate automatic task persistence after verifying missing-file
handling and cross-session round trips.

Store deadlines as LocalDate values, accept strict ISO input, and render
dates with a stable English display format.

Integrate validated LocalDate parsing and persistence after testing leap
dates, invalid input, and locale-independent output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract UI and task list responsibilities
commitResults.messageBody:
Move console interaction and collection mutations out of Mira so each
class owns one focused concern and remains independently testable.

Turn raw input into validated command objects before execution so Mira
coordinates focused UI, storage, parser, and task-list components.

Group commands, parsing, storage, tasks, UI, and exceptions by
responsibility while preserving src/main/java as the source root.

Adopt the course Gradle wrapper and configure it to build and run the
packaged mira.Mira entry point on Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for parser, storage, and task list
commitResults.messageBody:
Cover valid, boundary, and invalid behavior across three non-trivial
components while isolating persistence tests with temporary directories.

Name the standalone artifact mira.jar and document Gradle build and
launch steps so it can run from an otherwise empty folder.

Explain orchestration, parsing, storage, and task helpers so generated
API documentation is complete and passes strict doclint checks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Apply the SE-EDU Java coding standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Align switch blocks, grouped case labels, imports, and Javadoc
punctuation with the required basic and intermediate conventions.

Implement case-insensitive literal matching over task descriptions,
preserve result order, and cover empty and special-character searches.

Integrate complete API documentation after strict doclint and regression
checks.

Integrate the required SE-EDU formatting and documentation conventions
while preserving the JavaDoc branch changes.

Integrate task search while retaining the documentation and
coding-standard improvements from the other parallel branches.
